newsitem.title: JAPAN: SAKAKIBARA SAYS NO COMMENT ON DLR/YEN.
newsitem.headline: SAKAKIBARA SAYS NO COMMENT ON DLR/YEN.

text.p: Senior Japanese Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara declined to comment on Monday on the dollar's sharp fall against the yen in overseas markets last week.

"No comment," Sakakibara, vice minister for international affairs, said when asked how he viewed the dollar's fall of nearly four yen on Friday, triggered by a heavy sell-off in U.S. stocks and bonds.
The dollar was at around 115.50/60 yen in cautious trade on Monday morning in Tokyo, with the market eyeing movements in U.S. markets later in the day.
Sakakibara will be attending talks with officials from the International Monetary Fund, the United States and Asian nations on Monday to discuss an economic rescue package for Thailand.
